Regime: equity-only — Equity and vol rows only; credit is quiet.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.77% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +6bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.5pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 147 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 99 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 18.3 sits at the 65th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 11.4, so implied carries +6.9 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: Nvidia in talks to guarantee ~$250B financing for OpenAI's SoftBank-backed Ohio campus plus up to $350B in chip financing
items.note: Deepens the circular vendor-financing web (Nvidia backstopping the purchases of its own chips) underpinning the AI infrastructure debt build-out that credit investors are watching for contagion risk.

items.headline: Rising corporate borrowing costs threaten to squeeze heavily-indebted neoclouds and hyperscalers
items.note: Goldman Sachs' chief credit strategist warns that widening spreads will push AI capex funding toward private markets and JV structures as syndicated credit gets pricier, a direct signal of rising financing stress.

items.headline: Mag7 index posts worst day since April 2025 as Big Tech earnings collide with investor revolt over AI spending
items.note: Marks a break in the market's tacit tolerance for unchecked AI capex, coming right before Microsoft/Meta/Amazon/Apple report — a leading indicator for how capex guidance will be priced this week.

items.headline: 5-year CDS on Oracle, Amazon, Google and Microsoft hit multi-year highs as bond-market anxiety over AI capex grows
items.note: CDS spreads on the group ex-Oracle hit their highest since at least 2018 as fixed-income investors demand more compensation for hyperscaler AI-debt risk, a concrete credit-market stress signal.

items.headline: Alphabet posts first-ever negative quarterly free cash flow after lifting 2026 AI capex guidance to $205B
items.note: Shares fell ~7% and dragged the Mag7 index to its worst session in over a year, the clearest realized AI-revenue/capex disappointment so far this earnings season.
